data.name: Dayalu
data.gender_notes: Dayalu is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Dayalu is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘daya’ and ‘alu’. Daya means compassion, while alu means calm, steady. The name Dayalu signifies a person who is compassionate and steady in their actions and emotions. The name Dayalu carries the meaning “Daya (compassion) + Alu (calm, steady)” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dayalu usually hope their child will grow to embody daya (compassion) + alu (calm, steady) and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies compassion and calmness.
data.etymology: Dayalu belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Daya (compassion) + Alu (calm, steady).”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dayalu total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

historical_references.reference: Dayalu was a prominent Jaina patron and king of the Western Chalukya Empire in the 12th century. He is known for his contributions to the Jaina faith, including the construction of several temples and the patronage of Jaina scholars. He ruled from the capital of Belur and is famous for his inscriptions on the walls of the Hoysaleswara Temple.

Dayananda Saraswati, also known as Maharshi Dayanand, was a 19th-century Indian scholar and social reformer. He is the founder of the Arya Samaj, a Hindu reform movement that aimed to revive the ancient Vedic traditions and promote social reform. He challenged the caste system, advocated for the education of women, and promoted interfaith harmony.
